title: 美银Maddie Jow：铜供应紧张，AI和电网建设支撑需求
speaker: Maddie Jow

segments.en: Many can I ask you as well. What sort of assumptions you might be making on the UN for the back half of the year and how that informs commodity prices overall?
segments.zh: 我还想问，你对下半年美联储政策有何假设？这如何影响整体大宗商品价格？

segments.en: Yeah, so I would say that we are, so our house view is actually US to have 75 bips rate hike for the next 12 months. And then we are also expecting US dollar quite strong as well.
segments.zh: 我们的内部观点是，美国未来12个月将加息75个基点。同时我们预计美元将相当强劲。

segments.en: So, as a whole, it wouldn't benefit overall metals, apart from the, but of course, some of the metals may stand out from a supply demand perspective, like I said, copper, probably will stand out from a supply demand because very tight supply.
segments.zh: 总体而言，这对整体金属不利，但一些金属可能因供需面脱颖而出，比如铜，供应非常紧张。

segments.en: And then also, we are still having some very good support on the demand, like the greed building, the AI building as well.
segments.zh: 同时，需求仍有很好的支撑，比如电网建设和AI建设。
